apps.subtitle: Persistent data for Shortcuts
apps.localizedDescription: A private, typed data layer for Apple Shortcuts. Store shared variables, history, navigation, parking, music, Home, and system state on your device.

versions.localizedDescription: Adds encrypted password-protected exports, a complete import preview, safer validation, and one-tap undo for the latest successful import.
Adds English and Spanish app localization, an in-app language selector, the complete bilingual Shortcut collection, Schema 3 import, and automatic timestamps for mode changes.
